cffc1054bd8a80c260664ee07cca1d9712635f5b.summary: CrowdStrike adversary profile of SILENT CHOLLIMA, a DPRK-nexus actor active since at least 2007. CrowdStrike assesses it is likely affiliated with Lab 110 within Bureau 3 of the General Reconnaissance Information Bureau (GRIB). Listed community identifiers include Lazarus Group, Andariel and APT45. Stated objectives are financial gain, intellectual property theft, intelligence gathering and destruction; stated motivations are state-sponsored and criminal.

cfa1b91e1d42cd6d86d703f1f4ccf1e27b00340d.summary: Group-IB's DFIR team describes a campaign against CentOS VPS cloud hosts, beginning with SSH brute-force access and a malicious script. The script disables security controls, removes rival cryptocurrency miners, installs the Diamorphine rootkit, sets cron-based persistence, creates a backdoor root user and clears bash history. The report links it to the TeamTNT actor, active from 2019, dormant after 2022 and resurgent in 2023 to 2024, with moderate confidence. It says it cannot definitively confirm TeamTNT's involvement.

cf6d782a9ed23d0624252d04a5cabe070f3b16bb.summary: Microsoft reports North Korean actor Kimsuky has adopted ClickFix-style tactics. Targets, contacted by a fake South Korean official, get a spear-phishing PDF and are told to run attacker code in PowerShell as administrator, which installs a remote desktop tool and registers their device with a remote server. Limited attacks since January 2025 hit international affairs, NGO, government and media targets across four regions.
